name: Champion Microelectronic Corporation
summary: Champion Microelectronic Corporation is a company dedicated to the creation, production, and distribution of integrated circuits (ICs) for power management, serving markets throughout Asia, the United States, and Europe. Its extensive portfolio includes PFC/PWM controllers, high-performance resonant controllers, high power density and efficiency solutions, specialized chip designs, Ture No Standby solutions, gate drivers, and PFC diodes. These components find their primary utility in applications such as desktop computers, cloud servers, LED displays, and various other electronic systems. The firm was established in 1998 and operates from its main office in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
